# Glovanta Exim - AI-Readable Company Information

## Company Overview
Glovanta Exim is a leading exporter of premium quality products from India to global markets. We specialize in three main product categories: Spices, Dehydrated Products, and Textile Products.

## Export Process
1. Inquiry - Submit requirements through contact form or WhatsApp
2. Quotation - Receive detailed pricing within 24 hours
3. Sample - Review product samples
4. Order Confirmation - Finalize order details and payment terms
5. Production - Strict quality control measures
6. Shipping - Secure packaging and timely shipment
7. Delivery - Track shipment to destination
